info.name: BTCPay Greenfield API Keys Authorization API

params.name: permissions
params.description: The permissions to request. (See API Key authentication)

params.name: strict
params.description: If permissions are specified, and strict is set to false, it will allow the user to reject some of permissions the application is requesting.

params.name: selectiveStores
params.description: If the application is requesting the CanModifyStoreSettings permission and selectiveStores is set to true, this allows the user to only grant permissions to selected stores under the user's control.

params.name: redirect
params.description: The url to redirect to after the user consents, with the query parameters appended to it: permissions, user-id, api-key. If not specified, user is redirected to their API Key list.

params.name: applicationIdentifier
params.description: If specified, BTCPay Server will check if there is an existing API key associated with the user that also has this application identifier, redirect host AND the permissions required match(takes selectiveStores and strict into account). `applicationIdentifier` is ignored if redirect is not specified.

items.docs: Redirect the browser to this endpoint to request the user to generate an api-key with specific permissions
